name: hpc-grid
description: SPEC.md grid at HPC scale: 3 models x 5 T, N=500, R=1000

tasks.name: uv sync (from uv.lock)
tasks.command:
set -eo pipefail
uv sync --frozen
uv run python -c 'import numpy, pandas, pyarrow, matplotlib; print("deps ok")'

tasks.name: M0, T=3, N=500, R=1000
tasks.command:
set -eo pipefail
uv run python -m sim run --model M0 --T 3 --N 500 --R 1000 --seed 0 --out output/pilot/M0_T3_N500.parquet

tasks.name: summary, tables, figures, report
tasks.command:
set -eo pipefail
uv run python -m sim summary --output-dir output
uv run python -m sim figures --output-dir output
uv run python -m sim tables  --output-dir output
uv run python -m sim report  --output-dir output

# Provenance gate: every parquet must carry this commit and this SPEC.md hash.
uv run python -m sim check --output-dir output

# Surface the deliverables in the ScriptHut UI instead of making someone scp.
cp output/figures/*.png output/report.html output/summary.csv "$SCRIPTHUT_OUTPUT_DIR/"
cp output/tables/*.tex "$SCRIPTHUT_OUTPUT_DIR/" 2>/dev/null || true

{
  echo '## Figure 1 -- mean rho-hat against T'
  echo '![](fig1_mean_rho_by_T.png)'
  echo
  echo '## Figure 2 -- densities of rho-hat at T = 10'
  echo '![](fig2_density_T10.png)'
  echo
  cat output/table_main.md
  echo
  cat output/table_coverage.md
  echo
  cat output/table_variances.md
} > "$SCRIPTHUT_TASK_SUMMARY"

echo "- **grid**: 3 models x 5 values of T, N=500, R=1000 -- $(ls output/pilot/*.parquet | wc -l | tr -d ' ') cells, provenance PASS" \
  > "$SCRIPTHUT_RUN_SUMMARY"
